Test_Case: Open the website as a visitor
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the first page feels complete and trustworthy.
Description_Bullet_2: Check that important content appears without a blank screen or broken layout.
Preconditions: Tester is signed out and the application URL is available.
Test_Data: No special data required.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open the website in a new browser window. 2. Wait for the page to finish loading. 3. Look at the logo, navigation, hero, upcoming content, and footer. 4. Refresh once.
Expected_Result: The Home page loads both times with readable content, working images, and no visible error message.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm every main menu choice takes a visitor to the expected page.
Description_Bullet_2: Check that the fixed header remains usable after scrolling.
Preconditions: Use a desktop or laptop browser at least 1280 pixels wide.
Test_Data: About, Events, Seva, Hukamnama, Donation, Gallery, Contact.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Home. 2. Scroll halfway down the page and confirm the header is still available. 3. Open each main menu item one at a time. 4. Compare the page heading with the menu choice. 5. Return Home using the logo.
Expected_Result: Each menu item opens the correct page, no page shows a 404, and the logo returns to Home.

Test_Case: Use the mobile menu with one tap
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the hamburger menu opens and closes on the first tap.
Description_Bullet_2: Confirm the mobile menu calls the daily page Hukamnama.
Preconditions: Use a phone or a 390 x 844 browser viewport.
Test_Data: Menu item: Hukamnama.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Home on a phone. 2. Tap the hamburger once. 3. Find the Hukamnama menu item. 4. Tap it once. 5. Confirm the page opens. 6. Open the menu again and close it once.
Expected_Result: The drawer responds to single taps, shows Hukamnama rather than Daily Hukamnama, and navigates correctly.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm observance text is present and moves smoothly on a real phone.
Description_Bullet_2: Check that the ticker does not disappear or leave a long empty gap.
Preconditions: Use iPhone Safari if available; otherwise use another phone.
Test_Data: Observe for at least 30 seconds.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Home. 2. Keep the top ticker visible for 30 seconds. 3. Watch several items pass. 4. Rotate the phone once and rotate it back.
Expected_Result: Ticker text remains visible, moves smoothly, and is not clipped after rotation.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm Live Kirtan produces real audio rather than only changing the button state.
Description_Bullet_2: Check play, pause, and replay behavior.
Preconditions: Computer audio is on and the internet connection permits streaming.
Test_Data: Live Kirtan from Sri Darbar Sahib.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Home on desktop. 2. Press Play in the Live Kirtan control. 3. Listen for at least 10 seconds. 4. Pause. 5. Press Play again.
Expected_Result: Audio begins, continues without immediate failure, pauses, and resumes. The control matches the actual playback state.

Test_Case: Play Live Kirtan on mobile with single taps
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the Live popup and Play control each respond to one tap.
Description_Bullet_2: Confirm genuine audio continues after the popup opens.
Preconditions: Phone volume is on and silent mode is considered.
Test_Data: Live Kirtan from Sri Darbar Sahib.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Home on a phone. 2. Tap the Live control once. 3. Tap Play once. 4. Listen for at least 10 seconds. 5. Pause once. 6. Close the popup once.
Expected_Result: Every action responds to a single tap and real audio plays without showing a media error.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the popup header is dark, readable, and stays visible.
Description_Bullet_2: Confirm the X remains available after scrolling to the bottom.
Preconditions: Use a phone or a 390 x 844 browser viewport.
Test_Data: Navbar calendar button.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Tap the calendar icon once. 2. Confirm the header is dark blue with a white title and X. 3. Scroll to the bottom of the popup. 4. Confirm the header and X remain fixed at the top. 5. Tap X once.
Expected_Result: The dark header remains sticky, content scrolls underneath it, and one tap on X closes the popup.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm month arrows change the calendar without closing it.
Description_Bullet_2: Confirm selecting a date shows the matching observance details.
Preconditions: Calendar popup is open.
Test_Data: Previous month, next month, and any date containing an observance marker.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Note the current month name. 2. Tap Next once. 3. Confirm the month changes. 4. Tap Previous once. 5. Select a marked date. 6. Read the selected-day details.
Expected_Result: Month navigation is correct and the selected date details match the chosen calendar cell.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the realistic August events are available in chronological order.
Description_Bullet_2: Check that titles, dates, times, locations, and category styling are understandable.
Preconditions: The UAT seed has been run and the tester is on the Events page.
Test_Data: Sunday Asa Di Vaar and Family Diwan; New Family Welcome and Gurdwara Tour; Kids Gurmat Program Open House; Youth Kirtan and Tabla Practice; Seniors Wellness and Digital Safety Clinic; Milton Community Food Drive Collection Day.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Events. 2. Review the five-item Upcoming Events summary. 3. Use the calendar Next control to open August 2026. 4. Use Month or Agenda view to locate all six prepared events. 5. Compare their order and basic details.
Expected_Result: All six prepared events are available through the list and calendar, are ordered sensibly, and have no past or incorrect date.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the calendar clearly indicates a day containing several events.
Description_Bullet_2: Confirm the selected-day agenda shows all events for that date.
Preconditions: Prepared events are available.
Test_Data: August 2, 2026 has three prepared events.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Events. 2. Move the calendar to August 2026 if needed. 3. Select August 2. 4. Review the Selected Day count and agenda. 5. Open each August 2 event from the agenda.
Expected_Result: The selected day reports three events and each agenda item opens the correct event details.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm category filters change both the visible list and relevant calendar information.
Description_Bullet_2: Check Paath, Workshop, and Seva separately.
Preconditions: Prepared events are available.
Test_Data: Paath, Workshop, Seva.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Select Paath and note the results. 2. Select Workshop and note the results. 3. Select Seva and note the results. 4. Return the filter to All.
Expected_Result: Only matching events appear for each category and All restores the complete list.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the event popup presents useful information in a natural order.
Description_Bullet_2: Check image, description, date, time, location, capacity, and registration controls.
Preconditions: Prepared events are available.
Test_Data: Sunday Asa Di Vaar and Family Diwan.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open the named event. 2. Read the complete description. 3. Check the image and all detail labels. 4. Scroll through the popup. 5. Close it.
Expected_Result: All event information belongs to the selected event, is readable, and the popup closes normally.

Test_Case: Try to register with missing details
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the form explains what the user must correct.
Description_Bullet_2: Verify no registration is added from an incomplete form.
Preconditions: Open an event that accepts registration.
Test_Data: Leave required fields empty, then try an invalid phone or email.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open the registration form. 2. Submit it empty. 3. Enter an invalid contact value and submit again. 4. Read the messages shown.
Expected_Result: Submission is blocked, useful validation appears, and the event registration count does not increase.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm a visitor can register and receives clear confirmation.
Description_Bullet_2: Check that the registration remains after refreshing.
Preconditions: Use a test email and phone that have not been used for this event.
Test_Data: Event: New Family Welcome and Gurdwara Tour. Use the tester's name and a designated UAT email/phone.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open the event. 2. Enter the tester's name and contact details. 3. Submit once. 4. Confirm the success message. 5. Refresh the page and reopen the event.
Expected_Result: A single registration is saved, success feedback is clear, and the updated count remains after refresh.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm a tester can add one event to a personal calendar.
Description_Bullet_2: Check the downloaded item contains the correct event details.
Preconditions: Browser downloads are allowed.
Test_Data: Youth Kirtan and Tabla Practice.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open the named event. 2. Choose the calendar download action. 3. Open the downloaded ICS file or import preview. 4. Review title, date, time, and location. 5. Cancel the import if this is not a test calendar.
Expected_Result: A valid calendar item opens with details matching the website event.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm all prepared opportunities are easy to compare.
Description_Bullet_2: Check date, time, capacity, and open/closed state.
Preconditions: The UAT seed has been run.
Test_Data: Six opportunities from Sunday Langar Preparation Team through Food Drive Sorting and Vehicle Loading.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Seva Opportunities. 2. Find each prepared opportunity by its exact name. 3. Compare dates, time ranges, volunteer requirements, and status. 4. Confirm each prepared record is marked Open.
Expected_Result: All six prepared opportunities are visible with the intended dates, time ranges, capacities, and Open status.

Test_Case: Try seva registration while signed out
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the application protects member-linked seva registration.
Description_Bullet_2: Check that the user is guided to sign in and can return afterward.
Preconditions: Tester is signed out.
Test_Data: Any prepared open seva opportunity.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Seva Opportunities while signed out. 2. Choose Register on an opportunity. 3. Follow the sign-in prompt. 4. Use the browser Back button without entering credentials.
Expected_Result: The visitor is asked to sign in, sees no broken form, and can return safely to the Seva page.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm a signed-in member can submit a practical volunteer request.
Description_Bullet_2: Check that the opportunity count and family record update.
Preconditions: Tester is signed in with an approved test member account and has a phone or email on file.
Test_Data: Sunday Parking and Welcome Desk; add a short availability note.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open the named opportunity. 2. Review the prefilled member details. 3. Add the requested note. 4. Submit once. 5. Confirm the result. 6. Open Family Dashboard and check the registration.
Expected_Result: Registration is confirmed, appears against the correct opportunity, and is visible on the Family Dashboard.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the same member cannot accidentally register twice.
Description_Bullet_2: Check the original registration remains intact.
Preconditions: UAT-018 has been completed by the same member.
Test_Data: Sunday Parking and Welcome Desk with the same account/contact.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Return to the same opportunity. 2. Attempt to register again using the same account and contact. 3. Read the response. 4. Refresh the page.
Expected_Result: A clear already-registered message appears and only one registration exists.

Test_Case: Fill a small opportunity and test the waitlist
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm registrations beyond capacity are waitlisted rather than lost.
Description_Bullet_2: Use coordinated test accounts and do not reuse the same contact details.
Preconditions: Seniors Clinic Welcome and Accessibility Support has capacity 4; use five approved test members.
Test_Data: 1. Register four different members. 2. Confirm each is accepted. 3. Register a fifth member. 4. Check the fifth response and admin volunteer list.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: The first four are confirmed, the fifth is waitlisted, and totals clearly distinguish confirmed and waitlisted volunteers.
Expected_Result: High

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the current entry matches what an admin published for today's local date.
Description_Bullet_2: Check Gurmukhi, English content, Ang, and read-along controls.
Preconditions: Admin has published today's Hukamnama.
Test_Data: Use the same current entry shown on Home.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Note the Hukamnama summary on Home. 2. Open Hukamnama. 3. Compare date and Ang. 4. Read both language sections. 5. Start and stop the mini audio player.
Expected_Result: Home and Hukamnama show the same current entry and the audio belongs to its Ang.

Test_Case: Verify there is no false Ang 1 fallback
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm a missing current entry does not play unrelated Ang 1 audio.
Description_Bullet_2: This case should be coordinated with an admin only if today's entry can be safely unpublished and restored.
Preconditions: Temporarily missing current-day entry, then restore it immediately.
Test_Data: 1. Record the current entry. 2. Have an admin temporarily remove or reschedule it. 3. Refresh Hukamnama. 4. Check the message and audio area. 5. Restore the entry.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: The page says today's entry is unavailable and does not show or play an Ang 1 fallback.
Expected_Result: High

Test_Case: Jump between the heading and archive
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the Archives and Top pills remove unnecessary manual scrolling.
Description_Bullet_2: Check each pill with a single mobile tap.
Preconditions: Archive contains at least one older entry.
Test_Data: Archives pill at top; Top pill beside Archive heading.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Hukamnama at the top. 2. Tap Archives once. 3. Confirm the Archive heading is visible below the fixed navbar. 4. Tap Top once. 5. Confirm the page returns to the Hukamnama heading.
Expected_Result: Both pills scroll to the correct section, stay within the viewport, and work with one tap.

Test_Case: Search the archive by date and reset
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm exact-date searching is understandable.
Description_Bullet_2: Confirm Reset works on mobile and newest-first ordering returns.
Preconditions: Archive contains entries on multiple dates.
Test_Data: Choose the date of a known older Hukamnama.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Note the first archive date. 2. Enter a known archive date. 3. Confirm only that date is shown. 4. Tap Reset once. 5. Confirm the full newest-first list returns.
Expected_Result: The date filter returns the matching entry and Reset clears the field and restores the archive.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm archive details open in a focused popup.
Description_Bullet_2: Check bilingual content and the mini media player.
Preconditions: Archive contains a complete older entry.
Test_Data: Open the newest archive entry.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Select the newest archive card. 2. Confirm the popup date and Ang match the card. 3. Read Gurmukhi and English sections. 4. Play and pause the mini player. 5. Close the popup.
Expected_Result: The complete matching entry opens, both languages are readable, audio controls work, and the popup closes normally.

Test_Case: Check archive paging and today's exclusion
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm each page contains no more than 10 entries.
Description_Bullet_2: Confirm today's current Hukamnama is not duplicated in the archive.
Preconditions: Archive has more than 10 older entries and today's entry exists.
Test_Data: Current date and current Ang; archive pages 1 and 2.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Count entries on page 1. 2. Move to page 2. 3. Confirm the list changes. 4. Search both pages for today's date and current Ang. 5. Return to page 1.
Expected_Result: Page 1 contains at most 10 items, paging works, newest entries come first, and today's entry is absent from all archive results.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm campaigns and donation fields are understandable to a first-time donor.
Description_Bullet_2: Do not submit a real payment unless the test plan explicitly authorizes it.
Preconditions: Tester is signed out.
Test_Data: Use a small test amount only if Stripe test mode is confirmed.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Donation. 2. Review campaign cards and progress. 3. Select a campaign. 4. Enter donation details. 5. Stop before final payment if live mode is active.
Expected_Result: Campaign details are clear, required fields are identified, and no charge occurs during an unapproved test.

Test_Case: Use member dashboard links and CSV exports
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm Family Dashboard and Admin Portal links respond to a single mobile tap when authorized.
Description_Bullet_2: Confirm export buttons fit within the phone screen.
Preconditions: Use an approved privileged test account with dashboard data.
Test_Data: Family Dashboard, Admin Portal, available CSV exports.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open the profile lanyard on mobile. 2. Tap Family Dashboard once. 3. Confirm the page opens. 4. Check that export buttons do not overflow horizontally. 5. Download one CSV. 6. Return and tap Admin Portal once.
Expected_Result: Both links respond once, buttons fit the screen, and the CSV downloads with readable headings and data.

Test_Case: Contact the Gurdwara and use footer links
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm contact details and social links are useful and consistent.
Description_Bullet_2: Check that external links do not replace unfinished form content unexpectedly.
Preconditions: No sign-in required.
Test_Data: Address, phone, email, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Contact and review all displayed details. 2. Use the map/address link. 3. Scroll to the footer. 4. Open each social link in turn. 5. Confirm external sites open separately where expected.
Expected_Result: Contact information is consistent and each link opens the intended destination without a broken URL.

Test_Case: Subscribe with valid and invalid details
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm validation is helpful and a valid signup succeeds once.
Description_Bullet_2: Use a designated UAT email address.
Preconditions: First use an invalid email; then a valid test email and selected interests.
Test_Data: 1. Open Newsletter Signup. 2. Submit an invalid email. 3. Correct it and choose interests. 4. Submit once. 5. Refresh and avoid a second submission.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: Invalid data is blocked, the valid signup receives confirmation, and the page does not appear stuck while saving.
Expected_Result: Medium

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm valid admins reach the dashboard and signed-out visitors cannot bypass login.
Description_Bullet_2: Check error handling with one intentionally incorrect password.
Preconditions: Use approved UAT admin credentials; never record the password in this sheet.
Test_Data: Valid admin email; one wrong password attempt; then correct credentials.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Admin Portal signed out. 2. Try one wrong password. 3. Read the error. 4. Sign in correctly. 5. Confirm the Admin Dashboard opens. 6. Sign out and revisit /admin.
Expected_Result: Wrong credentials are rejected safely, correct credentials work, and /admin is protected after sign-out.

Test_Case: Review dashboard summaries and quick links
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm totals look plausible and links lead to the matching management page.
Description_Bullet_2: Check that no card shows undefined, NaN, or an invalid date.
Preconditions: Administrator is signed in and prepared data exists.
Test_Data: Events, seva, users, donations, and content summaries.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Review every dashboard summary. 2. Compare event and seva counts with their pages. 3. Open each quick link. 4. Return using the admin navigation.
Expected_Result: Summary values are readable and plausible, and each quick link opens the correct admin area.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm seeded public data is fully manageable from Admin Events.
Description_Bullet_2: Check descriptions, capacities, dates, categories, images, and active status.
Preconditions: Administrator is signed in and UAT seed has been run.
Test_Data: The six event titles listed in UAT-009.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Admin Events. 2. Search each prepared title. 3. Open View or Edit. 4. Compare all fields with the public event. 5. Cancel without changing data.
Expected_Result: Every prepared event appears once and admin details match the public page.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm a normal admin can create an event and see it publicly.
Description_Bullet_2: Use a clearly temporary UAT title so it can be deleted afterward.
Preconditions: Administrator is signed in.
Test_Data: Title: UAT Community Tea Test - [tester initials]; choose a future date and capacity 12.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Select Add Event. 2. Complete every required field. 3. Save once. 4. Refresh Admin Events. 5. Find the event publicly. 6. Record the result before cleanup.
Expected_Result: The event saves once, survives refresh, and appears publicly with matching details.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm edits persist and are reflected publicly.
Description_Bullet_2: Restore the original value after testing to protect shared fixture data.
Preconditions: Use the temporary event from UAT-034.
Test_Data: Append 'Updated' to its description and move the start time by 15 minutes.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Edit the temporary event. 2. Change the description and time. 3. Save. 4. Refresh admin. 5. Check the public event. 6. Restore the original values.
Expected_Result: Changes persist after refresh and public details update; restored values also persist.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm inactive events disappear publicly but remain manageable by admins.
Description_Bullet_2: Restore active status at the end.
Preconditions: Use the temporary event from UAT-034.
Test_Data: Temporary UAT event.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Set the event inactive. 2. Refresh Admin Events. 3. Search for it publicly. 4. Confirm it is absent. 5. Reactivate it. 6. Confirm it returns publicly.
Expected_Result: Inactive data stays in admin but is hidden publicly; reactivation restores it.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm admin can view, search, export, and remove a test registrant.
Description_Bullet_2: Use only a registration created during UAT and do not remove a real attendee.
Preconditions: Complete UAT-014 first.
Test_Data: Registration on New Family Welcome and Gurdwara Tour.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open the event registrant list. 2. Search the UAT tester. 3. Export CSV or PDF. 4. Check the downloaded row. 5. Remove that test registrant. 6. Refresh and verify the count.
Expected_Result: The tester appears once, export data is correct, removal succeeds, and counts update after refresh.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm prepared seva data is complete and correctly classified as open.
Description_Bullet_2: Check date, time, capacity, waitlist, and active status.
Preconditions: Administrator is signed in and UAT seed has been run.
Test_Data: The six seva names listed in UAT-016.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Admin Seva Opportunities. 2. Search each prepared name. 3. Open each record. 4. Compare fields with the public Seva page. 5. Cancel without changing data.
Expected_Result: Each prepared opportunity appears once and all public/admin values agree.

Test_Case: Create and edit a seva opportunity
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm a future opportunity can be created and edited normally.
Description_Bullet_2: Use a temporary UAT name and delete it after the case.
Preconditions: Administrator is signed in.
Test_Data: UAT Setup Support - [tester initials]; future date; 2 volunteers; waitlist enabled.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Add the temporary opportunity. 2. Save. 3. Refresh and reopen it. 4. Change its time and capacity. 5. Save and verify publicly. 6. Delete the temporary item.
Expected_Result: Create and edit values persist, the public card updates, and deletion removes only the temporary record.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm expired work cannot be incorrectly presented as active.
Description_Bullet_2: Do not alter a real upcoming opportunity.
Preconditions: Use the existing expired Cleaning or E2E record.
Test_Data: 1. Find an expired opportunity. 2. Confirm its status is Closed and cannot be toggled as if open. 3. Edit its date to a future test date. 4. Save. 5. Confirm status controls are available. 6. Restore the original date.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: Closed status is enforced for the past date and normal controls return for a future date.
Expected_Result: High

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm capacity and waitlist behavior is visible to administrators.
Description_Bullet_2: Complete UAT-020 first.
Preconditions: Seniors Clinic Welcome and Accessibility Support.
Test_Data: 1. Open the opportunity. 2. Review volunteer totals. 3. Confirm four people are confirmed and the fifth is waitlisted. 4. Search one volunteer. 5. Export the list. 6. Do not send a real reminder unless authorized.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: Admin totals, statuses, search, and export all agree with the five UAT registrations.
Expected_Result: High

Test_Case: Add two cash donations for the same donor
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm repeat donations are stored separately rather than treated as duplicates.
Description_Bullet_2: Check saving feedback and receipt renewal after each entry.
Preconditions: Use test records only and note their receipt IDs for cleanup.
Test_Data: Donor: UAT Sangat Member; amounts CAD 11 and CAD 21; use two dates.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Add Cash Donation. 2. Save the CAD 11 entry. 3. Confirm the modal stays open and shows a spinner followed by a green success message. 4. Note the fresh receipt. 5. Save CAD 21 for the same donor on the second date. 6. Search the donation list.
Expected_Result: Two distinct records exist with their own dates and receipts; both saves provide visible progress and success feedback.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm campaign totals and exported data agree with the visible records.
Description_Bullet_2: Avoid editing live campaign payment credentials.
Preconditions: Administrator is signed in.
Test_Data: Choose an active campaign with records.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open the campaign. 2. Compare raised amount, target, and donation rows. 3. Export available donation data. 4. Compare a few rows with the screen. 5. Cancel any edit form.
Expected_Result: Campaign calculations are plausible and exported rows match visible donation records.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm an unpaid member cannot be manually activated.
Description_Bullet_2: Confirm recording a valid membership payment activates the member automatically.
Preconditions: Use a dedicated inactive UAT member account.
Test_Data: One unpaid UAT member; one controlled membership fee payment.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Find the unpaid member. 2. Attempt manual activation and read the response. 3. Record the approved test membership payment. 4. Refresh the user. 5. Check active status and validity date. 6. Do not alter a real member.
Expected_Result: Unpaid activation is blocked; the payment activates the member and creates a clear validity period.

Description_Bullet_1: Confirm the acceptance email explains fees and includes the branded PDF.
Description_Bullet_2: Send only to a controlled UAT inbox with explicit authorization.
Preconditions: Use the dedicated UAT member and inbox.
Test_Data: Controlled approval action and received Membership Fee PDF.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Approve the UAT member. 2. Open the received email. 3. Check subject, greeting, fee guidance, and links. 4. Open the PDF attachment. 5. Inspect logo, member details, payment, validity, and page boundaries.
Expected_Result: Email wording is clear and the one-page PDF is branded, readable, correct, and free of clipping or overlap.

Test_Case: Publish today's Hukamnama and compare pages
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm an entry scheduled for the local date appears consistently.
Description_Bullet_2: Use a complete controlled entry and preserve the previous entry for restoration if needed.
Preconditions: Administrator is signed in.
Test_Data: Today's local date, a valid Ang, Gurmukhi lines, and English translation.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Create or edit today's entry in Admin Hukamnama. 2. Save and refresh admin. 3. Open Home in another tab. 4. Open Hukamnama. 5. Compare date, Ang, and text. 6. Confirm today is not duplicated in Archive.
Expected_Result: The same current entry appears on Home and Hukamnama, while Archive excludes today's date.

Test_Case: Make and restore a small content change
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm saved CMS text appears publicly and can be restored safely.
Description_Bullet_2: Copy the original text before editing.
Preconditions: Use a low-risk description field on a public page.
Test_Data: Append 'UAT check' temporarily to one description.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Record the original text. 2. Add the temporary phrase. 3. Save. 4. Refresh the matching public page. 5. Confirm the phrase. 6. Restore the exact original text and verify again.
Expected_Result: The public page follows the saved CMS value and the original content is restored exactly.

Test_Case: Check the Live Kirtan configuration safely
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm active stream settings match the public player.
Description_Bullet_2: Do not replace the production URL with an untrusted source.
Preconditions: Administrator is signed in and public playback was tested in UAT-005/UAT-006.
Test_Data: Current active Live Kirtan configuration.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: 1. Open Admin Streaming. 2. Identify the active configuration. 3. Compare its public availability with the Live player. 4. Toggle only if the test owner approves, then immediately restore it. 5. Replay public audio.
Expected_Result: Admin status and public availability agree, and restored playback still produces real audio.

Test_Case: Check permissions with a non-admin member
Description_Bullet_1: Confirm ordinary approved members cannot see or open admin-only areas.
Description_Bullet_2: Use separate approved member and admin accounts.
Preconditions: Family Dashboard and direct /admin URL.
Test_Data: 1. Sign in as the ordinary member. 2. Open the profile lanyard. 3. Confirm Admin Portal is absent. 4. Enter /admin directly. 5. Sign out and repeat as admin.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: The member is denied admin access while the authorized admin sees and opens Admin Portal.
Expected_Result: Critical

Test_Case: Confirm important admin actions are traceable
Description_Bullet_1: Check that audit entries identify what changed without exposing secrets.
Description_Bullet_2: Complete at least one event, seva, donation, or user action in this UAT run.
Preconditions: Use actions performed by the current tester.
Test_Data: 1. Open Audit Trail. 2. Filter or search for the tester's recent action. 3. Check timestamp, actor, action, and target. 4. Open details if available. 5. Confirm no password or payment secret is displayed.
Step_by_Step_Instructions: The action appears once with useful context and no sensitive credential data.
Expected_Result: High
